cutsceneViewBoundsContract.compilerRule: Final world scale is derived from natural asset Renderer bounds + actual cutscene camera visible bounds + requested screen fraction. Do not interpret words such as giant/small as raw Unity scale values.
cutsceneViewBoundsContract.unityExistingBridge: V3 already measures Renderer bounds through WorldToViewportPoint and supports requestedScreenHeightFraction/targetScreenHeightFraction. CUTSCENE_SCRIPT_V1 adapts into that existing spatial system instead of creating a second scale engine.
